description: Unsigned trial of an evaluation: send the evaluation request body (from recta_request_template, with a sender and recipient filled: no wallet needed: any sender address other than the zero address, and any recipient of the destination network's kind) and get whether a cheaper provable route exists for this exact transfer, the saving (lower bound, USDC) and Recta's 5 % of it. Names no route, stores nothing, charges nothing; 3 a day per IP address. To get the route, sign the same body with recta_prepare_signed_request and recta_send_signed_request.

body.description: The evaluation request body, as a JSON object or its JSON text.

name: recta_trial_evaluation
title: Would Recta save me money on this transfer? (free, no signature)
